Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
T.J.
Independent: T.J. may lock and burn 2 blood to cancel a referendum called by a titled Camarilla vampire.

What if T.J. locked,can him use his text with wake to burn 2 blood and cancel a referendum?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
No. "Lock X to do Y" requires the card X to be actually unlocked. Wakes only allow you to play reaction cards and attempt to block as if unlocked, nothing else.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Yomyael wrote:
> No. "Lock X to do Y" requires the card X to be actually unlocked. Wakes only allow you to play reaction cards and attempt to block as if unlocked, nothing else.
>
Correct, cf. rulebook www.vekn.net/rulebook

Wording templates
“Lock X to do Y”: Some cards use this wording, for instance: superior Bauble, Isanwayen. Such effects can’t be used by locked minions, even by those under a wake effect. These effects require an unlocked minion to be used. Conversely, “Lock X. Do Y” effects (for instance: Redirection) are usable by locked minions under a wake effect.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
